stem: In the figure, points \(A\), \(B\), \(C\), and \(D\) lie on the circle, and points \(C\) and \(D\) are on the same side of chord \(\overline{AB}\). The measure of angle \(ACB\) is \((4x + 7)^{\circ}\) and the measure of angle \(ADB\) is \((6x - 19)^{\circ}\). What is the value of \(x\)?
solution: Angles \(ACB\) and \(ADB\) are inscribed angles that intercept the same arc \(AB\), so they are equal.

explanation.A: Incorrect. \(2x = 16\) comes from a sign slip when moving the constants: \(19 + 7 = 26\), not \(19 - 7\).
explanation.B: Correct. Inscribed angles on the same arc are equal: \(4x + 7 = 6x - 19\) gives \(x = 13\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. \(26\) is the value of \(2x\); the last step, dividing by 2, was skipped.
explanation.D: Incorrect. \(59\) is the measure of each angle in degrees (\(4 \cdot 13 + 7\)), not the value of \(x\).

verify:
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
x=symbols('x')
ans=solve(Eq(4*x+7,6*x-19),x)[0]
assert ans==13
m=4*ans+7
assert abs(ang('A','C','B')-m)<0.1 and abs(ang('A','D','B')-m)<0.1
assert value(choices[answer])==ans
assert all(value(choices[k])!=ans for k in choices if k!=answer)
assert value(choices['D'])==m and value(choices['C'])==2*ans
